_comment: Henrik, Flora's husband, teaches Wild (the first taught combat skill); talking to him is an objective of `meat-for-dinner`. Standing talkable-NPC shape (miller.json): townsfolk, collisionLayer 97 without Action(2) so no aura targets it, role creature + speed 0, xpFactor 0. Dialogue from the PO's quest sheet. entityType Wanderer is placeholder art. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: Henrik

options.text: Flora sends me to hunt some deer.
How do I hunt a stag?

lines: With that tiny knife you carry? Hahaha! Come here, I'll teach you how to hunt.
I'll teach you one thing. Learn it properly.

grants.line: With the Wild aura you'll have a larger reach. Choose Wild as your active aura and give it your best shot!

options.text: No problem, I'll kill the deer in no time.

lines: A stag will start to run the moment you hurt it.
You won't win by hitting harder. You win by staying close.
